# FindMeCover

> FindMeCover (www.findmecover.co.uk) is a UK comparison site for boiler and central heating cover. It compares plans from HomeServe, Hometree and British Gas side by side, with prices checked daily against each provider's own website. Visitors don't sign up or share details; they click through to buy directly from the provider. Run by Jacob, who has worked in the home cover industry.

Prices below were last checked on 31 October 2026. They are each provider's lowest published monthly price for new homeowners, including any sale. Individual quotes vary by postcode, boiler and excess. Some links on the site are affiliate links; commission never affects how plans are ordered.

## Current plans and prices (checked 31 October 2026)

- HomeServe Gas Boiler cover (boiler only): £6.49/month; £100 excess; annual service not included; expected year-two price £15.55/mo; offer: Winter sale to 10 Feb. https://www.homeserve.co.uk/insurance/boiler-cover-service-xs1
- HomeServe Gas Boiler cover (boiler only): £7.99/month; £60 excess; annual service not included; offer: Winter sale to 10 Feb. https://www.homeserve.co.uk/insurance-cover/gas-and-boiler-comparison
- HomeServe Gas Boiler and Central Heating (boiler and central heating): £8.99/month; £60 excess; annual service not included; offer: Winter sale to 10 Feb. https://www.homeserve.co.uk/insurance/boiler-and-central-heating-cover-service-xs1
- Hometree Your Boiler (boiler only): £12.95/month; £0, £60 or £95 call-out; annual service included; offer: Up to 25% off to 3 Nov. https://www.hometree.co.uk/products/boiler-cover-insurance/
- British Gas HomeCare boiler and heating (boiler and central heating): £22.00/month; £60 excess (£0, £99 too); annual service included. https://www.britishgas.co.uk/cover/boiler-and-heating.html
- Hometree Your Heating (boiler and central heating): price on quote; £0, £60 or £95 call-out; annual service included; offer: Up to 25% off to 3 Nov. https://www.hometree.co.uk/products/boiler-cover-insurance/
- British Gas HomeCare boiler only (boiler only): price on quote; £0, £60 or £99 excess; annual service included. https://www.britishgas.co.uk/cover/boiler-and-heating.html

## Key pages

- [Compare boiler cover](https://www.findmecover.co.uk/): all plans side by side, filterable by cover type and annual service, sortable by price or customer rating.
- [Boiler cover prices](https://www.findmecover.co.uk/guides/boiler-cover-prices.html): every plan's year-one and year-two price, excess and offers, updated daily.
- [Boiler cover calculator](https://www.findmecover.co.uk/guides/boiler-cover-calculator.html): compares two years of cover with paying for repairs yourself.
- [About FindMeCover](https://www.findmecover.co.uk/about.html): who runs the site, how prices are checked, and how the site makes money.
